definitions.explanation: Chinese-style cooking, especially as adapted and enjoyed in Japan. Often used as a prefix for Chinese food items.
Relating to China or Chinese culture more broadly, though the food-related sense is by far the most common in daily use.

notes:
{中華|ちゅうか} most commonly refers to Chinese cuisine in everyday conversation.

COMMON FOOD COMPOUNDS:
- {中華|ちゅうか}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (Chinese cuisine)
- {中華|ちゅうか}{鍋|なべ} (Chinese-style wok; Chinese hot pot)
- {中華|ちゅうか}そば (Chinese-style noodles, ramen)
- {中華|ちゅうか}{丼|どん} (Chinese rice bowl)
- {中華|ちゅうか}{街|がい} (Chinatown)
- {中華|ちゅうか}まん (Chinese steamed bun)

In Japan, {中華|ちゅうか}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ often refers to Chinese food that has been adapted to Japanese tastes, while ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ may refer to more authentic Chinese cuisine.
